snippet.title: Layer Cake - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2987030/Layer_Cake

The game originally started as a game jam entry and spiraled into what it is now. You can play that demo on itchio, although its outdated:
https://xaijeistou.itch.io/layer-cake

Song is сломанная лента by Sorry about my face
